replies.author: @duesen00
replies.text: As a Latvian who has studied the Estonian and livonian languages and cultures, I must say that Estonians culturally speaking are extremely close to Latvians. There's really many things that are extremely similar in both cultures. Even in terms of language, even though both languages are unrelated. Both languages influenced each other for millennia extensively. So I kind of dislike this narrative that Estonians are nothing like their Baltic brothers and sisters. Yes they're obviously very close to Finnish people too, and often in more obvious ways than with Latvians and Lithuanians. But whenever I'm in Estonia, to me it feels just like Latvia but with better roads and a language that is very different but still somewhat familiar.
